# Refund a late capture in full

## Context and Problem Statement

A payment provider can confirm a capture after the hold it was taken against
has already expired and the seats have gone back on sale.

## Considered Options

- Refund the capture in full and tell the fan.
- Keep the money and issue a ticket for whatever seats are left.

## Decision Outcome

Chosen option: "Refund the capture in full and tell the fan", because the seats
the fan paid for are the only ones the fan agreed to buy.

### Consequences

- Good, because a fan is never charged for seats they did not choose.
- Bad, because a sold-out event refunds fans who were seconds late.
